title: Main Theme (Overworld)
note: Capo 1 turns a B flat tune into A, G, F and E shapes. It is a march: four firm downstrokes a bar, and a new chord nearly every bar, so loop the first four bars of A until the hand moves on its own. F7 is the F barre with the little finger lifted. The tune itself is left out.
remarks: Sounds in B flat; shapes are a semitone lower for capo 1. Layout from ChordWiki (4/4, 150): intro 4 bars, A 8, B 12, then A again. Hooktheory (12/8, 154) agrees on the opening chords of each part but holds the first chord where ChordWiki steps down. Bass pickups and slash basses left out; the F7 in B3 comes on beat 4.
